# Original-script regression fixtures

These SVG files are raw black-box outputs generated by running the user-supplied Illustrator script:

`AI脚本插件146合集-146版.jsx` → `盒型2.0` → `锁底盒`

They are test evidence only. Runtime code does not load or execute the proprietary JSX, Illustrator, or any website.

| Fixture | Lock-bottom parameters | Target top-level group | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `box-v2-lock-bottom-80x40x120.svg` | L80 W40 H120 S0.5 T12 G11 mm | 2 | `22883bb3d70d46a311b8e944d068246430a8f23863e0a1f9274e1fa52b6b8619` |
| `box-v2-lock-bottom-100x55x160.svg` | L100 W55 H160 S0.7 T15 G14 mm | 3 | `b915da2bef3de5250404eae699ef2c1f868477dbfec96b3cbb271ae76ef59e8a` |

The files also contain earlier groups because the original ScriptUI action appended each result to the active Illustrator document. Regression tests intentionally select the documented target group, discard empty Illustrator paths, convert points to millimetres, and compare primitive kind, path command topology, sequence, and every coordinate.
